test_name: Verify Pagination Workflow for Test Suites
description: Tests the navigation between pages using pagination controls.
steps: Verify the presence of pagination controls (First, Last, Arrow Left, Arrow Right).
Click on the 'Next' button and verify that the next page is displayed.
Click on the 'Previous' button and verify that the previous page is displayed.
Click on the 'First' button and verify that the first page is displayed.
Click on the 'Last' button and verify that the last page is displayed.
Click on a specific page number and verify that the corresponding page is displayed.
Attempt rapid navigation through pages and verify no UI glitches occur.
expected_results: Pagination buttons correctly navigate to the intended pages.
No UI glitches or errors during navigation.
The table updates dynamically to display the corresponding page's content.
edge_cases: Clicking 'First' on the first page should not reload the page.
Clicking 'Last' on the last page should not reload the page.
Navigating rapidly through pages should not cause performance issues.
UI should handle scenarios where there is only one page of test suites.
Invalid page numbers should not crash the application.
data_requirements: Multiple pages of test suites available in the database.
A test setup with only one page of test suites.
Test suite data distributed across pages for testing navigation.
dependencies: Availability of test suite data across multiple pages.
Proper API endpoints for fetching paginated data.
api_interactions: GET requests to fetch data for specific pages during navigation.
Error handling for API failures during pagination.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load a new page of test suites.
Memory usage while navigating through multiple pages rapidly.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure all pagination buttons are keyboard accessible.
ARIA labels for pagination controls to aid screen readers.
Focus indication for each pagination button.
